provenance.source: hand-compiled from standard English-language community/organizational plan-document section conventions (goals/targets/objectives; current-state/baseline/status reporting; intervention/metric/indicator tables; definitions/glossary sections). The definition vocabulary is directly confirmed against a real document: Houston's FY2025 HUD Consolidated Plan glossary section (houston-consolidated-plan.pdf) uses exactly 'Definitions' as its section heading over real HUD-defined terms (Chronically Homeless, Continuum of Care, Emergency Shelter, HMIS, Subrecipient).
